meta.name: infographic
meta.description: Create template-based infographics with space-separated key-value syntax (NOT YAML). Best for KPI dashboards, timelines, roadmaps, SWOT analysis, funnels, comparisons, and org charts with quick visual impact.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用键值对语法快速创建信息图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作可视化图表和仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Create infographics quickly with key-value syntax
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create visual charts and dashboards

howto.what: Claude 会根据你提供的模板名称和数据，生成一个信息图（如 KPI 仪表盘、时间线、路线图、SWOT 分析、漏斗图、对比图、组织架构图等）。你只需用空格分隔的键值对语法描述内容，Claude 就会输出对应的 Markdown 代码块，渲染后即可看到可视化图表。
howto.when: 当你需要快速创建可视化图表或信息图时，例如展示 KPI 数据、项目时间线、产品路线图、SWOT 分析、漏斗转化、对比分析或组织架构等场景。

say.text: 用 list-grid-badge-card 模板展示季度 KPI 数据
say.note: Claude 会生成一个卡片式网格信息图

say.text: 用 sequence-timeline-simple 画一个产品路线图
say.note: Claude 会生成一个时间线信息图

say.text: 用 compare-swot 做 SWOT 分析
say.note: Claude 会生成一个 SWOT 矩阵

howto.what_en: Claude generates an infographic (e.g., KPI dashboard, timeline, roadmap, SWOT, funnel, comparison, org chart) based on your chosen template and data. You provide space-separated key-value pairs, and Claude outputs a Markdown code block that renders as a visual chart.
howto.when_en: When you need to quickly create a visual chart or infographic, such as for KPI dashboards, project timelines, product roadmaps, SWOT analysis, funnel conversion, comparisons, or org charts.

say_en.text: Use list-grid-badge-card to show quarterly KPIs
say_en.note: Claude generates a card grid infographic

say_en.text: Draw a product roadmap with sequence-timeline-simple
Do a SWOT analysis with compare-swot
